# Ranked XI

> Ranked XI is the national table of American soccer: every club from MLS to the grassroots, men's and women's, ranked on one scale.

Independent project. Not affiliated with any league, club or federation. Not betting advice.
Ratings are recomputed twice daily; every page carries the date its figures were computed.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.rankedxi.com/): the map and the national table
- [The US soccer pyramid, ranked](https://www.rankedxi.com/us-soccer-pyramid): every tier with the median rating of each league
- [Methodology](https://www.rankedxi.com/methodology): how the ratings are built and what each basis label means
- [FAQ](https://www.rankedxi.com/faq): twelve most-asked questions, answered
- [About](https://www.rankedxi.com/about): who builds this
- [UPSL national rankings](https://www.rankedxi.com/upsl-rankings): the national table UPSL does not publish
- [NPSL national rankings](https://www.rankedxi.com/npsl-rankings): the national table NPSL does not publish
- [Terms, privacy & notices](https://www.rankedxi.com/terms): corrections and removal process

## Structure

- `/club/{slug}` — one page per club: rating, basis, league rank, national rank, movement, nearest rivals
- `/league/{slug}` — one page per league: full rated table
- `/state/{code}` — one page per US state or Canadian province

## Facts

- Men's and women's clubs are rated on the same scale but ranked in separate tables; they do not play each other.
- Every rating is labelled: real results, real standings, an independent results model, or illustrative.
- Cross-league placement is calibrated on roughly 600 U.S. Open Cup results across five editions — the only competition where clubs from different tiers meet.
- A strong amateur club can rate above a weak professional one. That is a finding, not a bug.
- College ratings are placed, not measured: college teams never play in the Open Cup, so divisions are ordered by independent Massey ratings and mapped into calibrated bands.
- Clubs whose divisions publish no usable table are listed without a rating rather than being given an invented one.
- Youth clubs are organization listings only. No youth ratings, no youth player data, no personal information about minors.
